name: Zumbro River (Green Bridge–Kellogg)

gaugeContext.note: The USGS Zumbro Falls station reports water level rather than current discharge. No suitable discharge feed is assigned; an upstream South Fork reading is not presented as the flow for these main-river trips.
gaugeContext.sourceName: USGS — Zumbro River at Zumbro Falls, station 05374000

timing.note: No reviewed flow-to-speed model or matching numeric agency trip times. Public access maps and sourced planning distances remain useful without a live estimate.

blurb: Paddle beneath southeastern Minnesota’s bluffs, from the Green Bridge and Zumbro Falls day-trip corridor to shorter outings around Theilman, Funk Ford, Kruger and Kellogg.

sections.difficulty: Lively current and riffles; snags possible
sections.notes: A DNR-recommended paddle through a bluff-lined valley below Lake Zumbro Dam. Start at Green Bridge and finish at the public Zumbro Falls access; carry-in access at the start requires moving your boat from the parking area.

notices.title: Fast-rising water and snags
notices.text: The Zumbro can rise quickly after heavy rain. Check DNR river conditions before launching and watch for downed trees and changing channels.
notices.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — Zumbro River State Water Trail

putInAccess.note: Agency digitized point falls among trees between the access road and river. The current DNR map documents carry-in access at mile 55.8. Retained as an approximate area, not an exact landing.
putInAccess.directions: Use the DNR carry-in beside County Road 7/Green Bridge, downstream of Lake Zumbro Dam. Follow the public access entrance and carry your boat to the river; do not launch at the bridge or reservoir dam.

takeOutAccess.operator: Minnesota DNR, Division of Parks and Trails
takeOutAccess.sourceName: Minnesota DNR — 2026 Zumbro River map and public-access inventory
takeOutAccess.note: Unchanged DNR point aligns with the visible shoreline launch approach beside Highway 63. The inventory lists a concrete-slab trailer ramp and the 2026 map lists carry-in access; use the signed public facility. Desktop landing review, not a field survey.
takeOutAccess.directions: From Highway 63 just south of Zumbro Falls, turn east on County Road 11 and follow the public access entrance on the right. The landing is beside the downstream side of the highway bridge.
takeOutAccess.bankNote: Current DNR map and access inventory identify river left, facing downstream. The unchanged agency coordinate aligns with the shoreline approach in imagery.
